visual_elements.description: DECODER (inside yellow rounded rectangle). Three identical time-step columns, left to right. Each column, top to bottom: output label o₁ / o₂ / o₃ (italic serif, dark olive) at top; black upward arrow from a green cell to the label with italic 'softmax' label placed to the left of the arrow; a light-green rectangle divided into 3 equal segments (softmax/output layer); black downward arrow; a light-orange rectangle divided into 3 equal segments (RNN hidden cell). Horizontal black right-arrows connect the orange cells: first connector labeled s₁, second labeled s₂, and a third arrow exits the right edge of the third orange cell labeled s₃. Two thin black curved arrows swoop from beneath the s₁ and s₂ connectors, dip downward and curve up into the bottom edges of the second and third orange cells (recurrent feedback). A small solid red dot sits at the left edge of the first orange cell (context-vector entry point).

ENCODER (inside peach rounded rectangle). Top row: three pink/salmon rectangles each divided into 3 equal segments (RNN hidden cells), connected left to right by black arrows; first connector labeled h₁, second labeled h₂; a black arrow enters the first pink cell horizontally from the left edge of the container (unlabeled initial state); a small solid red dot sits at the right edge of the third pink cell. Bottom row: three tan rectangles each divided into 3 equal segments (input cells), one beneath each pink cell. Black upward arrows run from each tan cell to the pink cell above, each labeled to its left in italic dark-olive text: 'embedding x₁', 'embedding x₂', 'embedding x₃'. At the very bottom, black upward arrows rise from the labels x₁, x₂, x₃ into each tan cell.

Context-vector connector: thin red curved arrow starting at the red dot on the right edge of the encoder's third pink cell, arcing upward and to the right, terminating with an arrowhead at the red dot on the left edge of the decoder's first orange cell.

recreation_brief: 1. Set a 16:9 slide with white background. Draw a rounded rectangle covering approx left 4%, top 8%, right 96%, bottom 99%; no fill, 2pt border in #C0504D. 2. Add a centered text box at top (y 10%-17%) with the exact text 'Traditional RNN  Seq2Seq model' (keep the wide double space), Arial bold 28pt, color #E0301E. 3. Top-right corner: draw a 0.45in circle, fill #FFFF00, 1.5pt outline #1F3864, centered text '6' in dark red (#8B0000), ~14pt. 4. Decoder container: rounded rectangle at x 50%-94%, y 21%-54%, fill #F2F25C, no border. Above its right portion add right-aligned text 'Decoder (RNN)', Arial bold italic 18pt, #E0301E. 5. Inside the decoder, build three evenly spaced columns (i = 1,2,3). Per column top-to-bottom: italic serif label o₁/o₂/o₃ (#7F6000); black up-arrow from the green bar to the label with italic 'softmax' (#7F6000) placed left of the arrow; a green bar (fill #9CE05C, ~0.9in x 0.28in) subdivided by two thin vertical lines into 3 cells; black down-arrow; an orange bar (fill #F7C683, same size, subdivided into 3 cells). 6. Connect the orange bars with black right-arrows: label the first 's₁' and second 's₂' (italic serif, #7F6000); add a third arrow exiting the right edge labeled 's₃'. Add two thin black curved connectors that start under the s₁/s₂ arrows, dip down, and curve up into the bottoms of the 2nd and 3rd orange bars. Place a small solid red (#C00000) dot on the left edge of the first orange bar. 7. Encoder container: rounded rectangle at x 5%-50%, y 56%-92%, fill #FAC090, no border. Below it add centered text 'Encoder  (RNN)', Arial bold italic 18pt, #E0301E. 8. Inside the encoder, top row: three pink bars (fill #F2A396, ~0.9in x 0.3in, each subdivided into 3 cells) evenly spaced; black right-arrows between them labeled 'h₁' and 'h₂' (italic serif, #7F6000); a black arrow entering the first bar from the left container edge; a solid red dot on the right edge of the third bar. 9. Bottom row: three tan bars (fill #E6C49C, subdivided into 3 cells) aligned under the pink bars; black up-arrows from each tan bar to the pink bar above, each labeled at its left in italic #7F6000: 'embedding x₁', 'embedding x₂', 'embedding x₃'; black up-arrows from bottom labels 'x₁', 'x₂', 'x₃' into the tan bars. 10. Draw a thin red (#C00000) curved arrow from the encoder's red dot up to the decoder's red dot, arrowhead at the decoder end. 11. Add a rectangle at x 58%-87%, y 75%-82%, fill #FFC0CB, 1.5pt red border, centered bold red text 'Context Vector (of Whole Inputs)' (Arial bold ~14pt, #FF0000). Draw a thin straight red leader line from the encoder's right edge near the red dot down to the callout's top-left corner. 12. For all subscripts use true subscript formatting (or Unicode ₁₂₃) in an italic serif font such as Cambria Math or Times New Roman Italic, color #7F6000.
